p.i: Quædam etiam imparisyllaba hic declinantur, ut

main_text.p: Nomina Attice flexa. Nomina sic Atticè flexa, præter jam exposita, hæc paucula sunt:

ἡ γαλαως (poëticè γαλεως) glos, soror viri. Sic composita ἀ γαῖα vel γέα terra, ἀ γέλως risus, ἀ γηρως senectus, ἡ κέρως cornu, ἡ κρέας caro, ἡ γρέεως debitum, necessitas, (quod neutrum unicum est in ως, dativo τῷ γρέει, ἡ [?]

page.notes: Greek accents and breathings in the Atticè and composita lines are hard to read at this scan quality and are marked as doubtful where uncertain. The last line is partly obscured by a stain and a small mark ("e ἡ") below it. The Greek items in the list are transcribed as far as legible. Some Greek words in the paragraph "Sic composita" may be misread.
